title: trema timorense
intro: Trema timorense, commonly known as the Timor trema or butterfly tree, is a plant species native to the Pacific islands, including Timor and the surrounding islands. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can aid in the treatment of various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Trema timorense include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and act as an expectorant, making it a useful remedy for respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
